description: Edit an existing post. Pass the post's `slug` and a `patch` of fields to change; `coverImage: null` removes the cover. Use this when the user wants a published post or draft changed. `patch: { status: "draft" }` takes a live post offline and `"published"` puts a draft live. Slug itself can't change; delete and republish if you need a new URL. Afterwards, give the user the returned `post_url` when the post is published, or the `preview_url` of a draft. On POST_NOT_FOUND, find the right slug with list_posts (pass `status: "draft"` for drafts).

blog_id.description: Your blog's id, as returned by signup. Optional with an API key: it defaults to the key's blog, and any id you pass must be that blog. Required when the server runs without API keys.

idempotency_key.description: Optional retry key, any unique string (e.g. a UUID). Retrying with the same key and identical arguments returns the first result instead of writing again; the same key with different arguments fails with IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_CONFLICT. Scoped to your API key and this tool.

patch.description: Fields to change; omitted fields stay as they are. Same fields as create_post except `slug`, which cannot change.

author.description: New author name, up to 100 characters.

body.description: New markdown body. Replaces the whole body. {{fact:name}} shows the current value of the blog's live fact `name`.

coverImage.description: Cover image URL (http/https). Send null to remove the cover.

excerpt.description: New summary shown under the title in the post list, up to 300 characters.

language.description: Language of this post as a BCP-47 tag, e.g. "en", "ru", "pt-BR". Send null to clear the override and inherit the blog's language.

seoDescription.description: New description for search results and link previews, up to 300 characters.

seoTitle.description: New title for search results and link previews, up to 200 characters, used exactly as written.

status.description: "published" puts the post live; "draft" takes it offline.

tags.description: New tag list, e.g. ["ai"]. Replaces all tags; [] removes them.

title.description: New title, 1–200 characters. The slug stays the same.

translationOf.description: Slug of a post in this blog to link as a translation of this one. Send null to unlink this post from its translation group.

slug.description: Slug of the post, e.g. "hello-world", as returned by create_post or list_posts.

name: update_post

error.description: Present only on failure (isError: true). Success fields are absent then.

details.description: Extra context. Keys depend on the code.

message.description: What went wrong and what to do next.

language.description: The post's own BCP-47 language tag. Absent: it uses the blog's language.

publishedAt.description: ISO 8601 publish time. null for drafts.

translationGroup.description: Shared by every translation of the same post.

post_url.description: Live URL of the post. Present only when it is published.

preview_url.description: Private link to a rendered draft for the human to review: not indexed, not listed anywhere. Present only for drafts, on hosts with previews.

title: Update post
